title: List of Subscribers, February 21, 1878
version: Dated one-sheet company broadside. Connecticut Humanities facsimile credited to the Southern New England Telephone Company Records, Archives & Special Collections, University of Connecticut Library.
lineage: Read the complete image of the operator's printed sheet. The Connecticut Humanities caption traces the image to UConn's Southern New England Telephone Company Records, whose directory catalogue handle is 11134/20002:860264839. Library of Congress reel 0 905006, image 12, is a separate reproduction of the same edition and supplies no independent evidence of operations.

passages.note: Header gives the company name, 219 Chapel Street office and 21 February 1878. The two columns list residences, physicians, dentists, miscellaneous entries, stores and factories, meat and fish markets, and hack and boarding stables.
Footer gives office hours of 6 a.m. to 2 a.m. and announces all-night opening after March 1. The latter is a prospective statement.
M. F. Tyler appears under Residences and with Law Chambers under Miscellaneous; New Haven Flour Co. has four location lines, three printed using ditto marks.

file.method: Unchanged image of the full broadside as served by Connecticut Humanities.
